changes: Explicit opt-in projective-geometry recording gate; unchanged Newton reference gate. Captures both access results without invented residuals or equilibrium certificates.
Full PD recording/replay now runs through the application input handler and shared-clock barrier, with the right access in a worker and full RTG.
Enabled passing 025 contact-row/vector/triangle/projection workspaces in the isolated preset only; rejected 026 deferred witnesses remain disabled.
Local anatomy asset copies replace a symlink that Vite rejected. Added an explicit button loading the original 7507-command recording.

tests.workerScope: 125 moving steps across the sheath exit: bit-identical body arrays, PD results, geometry and frozen flow samples; publication only in step().

fullApplication.timingScope: Full application with RTG, shared clock and right worker; independent user-facing PD simulator remained running on port 5182. Timing is observed performance under that concurrent workload, not an isolated-machine comparison.

iterations12Screen.decision: Functionally passes coarse checkpoints, but no controlled speed improvement established. Lower local-iteration cost is partly replaced by a higher global-closure cost. Not promoted to manual preset.

limitations: 60 common physics Hz was not achieved.
The manual simulator remained active; timings are observations under that concurrent workload, not controlled comparisons with older runs.
Five coarse route checks and sampled geometry gates do not independently certify full visual realism, femoral entry or wall containment between samples.
PD remains an approximate positional-friction/chordal-rod model and has no Newton equilibrium certificate.
next: Optimize global geometric closure and retained contact handling. Re-test the previously functional fine-prefix-250 adaptive PD mesh with the 025 kernels, comparing complete trajectories with alternating paired timing before full-app acceptance.
